$comment: RULE: never put a credential in this file. It is committed to git, so a
password pasted into an allow entry is a password in the repository's
history forever. Allow the shape of a command, not a command with a secret
baked into it — use a wildcard where the secret would go, or don't allow it.
The entries below cover the routine build/test/inspect loop. Anything that
writes to the server is deliberately absent: a deploy is an operator
decision, and it goes through deploy/deploy.ps1.
